guildName.description: The name of the guild to collect reports for.

serverName.description: The server slug/name that the guild is found on.

pathParams.description: The short region name for the server.

start.description: Optional start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If omitted, 0 is assumed.

end.description: Optional end time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds. If omitted, the current time is assumed.

owner.description: The user that uploaded the report.

zone.description: The zone ID for the report. A value of -1 means the zone is not known.

start.description: The report start time as a Unix timestamp in milliseconds.
